buyers.store_credit_bonus: +25% in store credit (all rates quoted below as 'credit' already include the 25%)
buyers.minimum: No minimum stated; CSI's article says bulk sellers usually want at least 1,000 cards but there is no upper limit. Account required.

buyers.condition_rules: Sell List FAQ: do not send bulk in played condition or non-English. Full Service Selling: English only; non-English discarded. Played singles pay up to 75% of NM price.

buyers.excluded: Non-English cards; played-condition bulk. Large collections (about 100,000+ cards) should email buyer@coolstuffinc.com first.
buyers.turnaround: Orders of 1,000 cards or fewer processed in about 7 business days after marked Received (larger: +2 to 10 business days). Payment sent 1-2 business days after processing.
buyers.process: Create account, open Full Service 'Get Started' form (or build a Sell List cart) to generate a Sell Order #, wait for approval email, pick payment type (check/PayPal/credit) after approval, ship in a sturdy box labelled c/o Buyer - Sell Order ID#, 8550 S. US Hwy 17-92, Maitland FL 32751.

buyers.name: Sell2BBNovelties (BB Novelties / BBToyStore)
buyers.store_credit_bonus: +25% in BBToyStore.com store credit
buyers.minimum: Each box needs at least $30.00 of merchandise to qualify for a prepaid shipping label (under $30 the seller pays shipping). Must be 18+.
buyers.shipping: Orders over $30: Sell2BB emails a prepaid UPS (sometimes USPS) label for most US addresses. Under $30 seller pays. Process one order per box. Quoted prices lock for 14 days after the order is submitted.
buyers.condition_rules: Yu-Gi-Oh, Lorcana, One Piece, DBS: must be Mint (like new, no bends/creases/scratches/white edges). US/English versions only, no fakes. Non-mint cards are returned (return shipping arranged at their cost unless a label was supplied and the cards were 'not as described'). Sports: near mint to mint.
buyers.sorting_rules: Flat-rate sell: separate cards by type (holos/rares apart from commons). Keep individually listed cards in order shown on the order. Remove from 9-pocket pages, soft sleeves and top loaders. Excessive duplicates of one card should be limited (contact first). Whole-collection listings must be on an order by themselves.
buyers.excluded: A price of $0.00 means 'enough stock, not buying right now'. Digimon: only sealed booster packs/boxes are listed (no flat bulk rate). Sports: eras 1980s-2010s have no guaranteed price ('$0.00+ (contact us)'). Pauses all purchasing in November and December (page banner: 'Holiday Purchasing Policy: November & December 2026').
buyers.turnaround: Confirms receipt/inspection within 1 week (often sooner); PayPal paid within 1 business day of approval.
buyers.process: Browse buy list, add flat-rate listing to basket, submit sell order (no account login needed to view; basket checkout), wait for confirmation email with shipping label/instructions, ship within 14 days.
buyers.rates_last_updated: No date on the category pages; banner 'Holiday Purchasing Policy: November & December 2026' shows the pages are current as of late 2026.
buyers.reputation: Says it has run this buying service since mid-2003 and the retail site BBToyStore.com since 1999; ~99% of submissions accepted, 10-25 submissions/day (self-reported).

buyers.name: Star City Games
buyers.store_credit_bonus: None on bulk: help center says 'Sealed products and bulk items sold for store credit do not receive a trade-in bonus' (bonus applies only to eligible non-bulk items). Bulk credit value = cash value.
buyers.minimum: No minimum quantity stated for bulk. Check payment needs a Sell List total of at least $10. Star City account required (Sell List and Ship + Sell).
buyers.shipping: Seller pays all shipping to Roanoke VA, and return shipping on rejects (Ship + Sell declined offers: SCG pays return within continental US). Sell List requests must be postmarked within 2 business days of approval to hold prices; Ship + Sell has no ship deadline. Customs/postage due deducted from payout. Also buys in person at the Roanoke store (appointment) and at SCG CON booths.
buyers.volume_bonus: None for bulk. Ship + Sell processing fee drops from 10% to 5% on requests of $10,000 or more.
buyers.condition_rules: Bulk must be Near Mint or Played, English. Heavily Played bulk is not purchased. Bulk rates adjusted down (or refused) if guidelines not met.
buyers.sorting_rules: Unsleeved, out of binders/top-loaders, all cards facing the same direction. Bulk commons/uncommons must be a good mix of both rarities; bulk basic lands must be a mix of land types. Sell List route: bulk is added to the cart by quantity under 'Bulk'; cards in listed order (up to 5% penalty otherwise). Ship + Sell route: send unsorted, SCG sorts and grades, but deducts a 10% processing fee (5% if $10k+); any single card whose Sell List price is under $1 is paid at the bulk price.
buyers.excluded: Per help center: bulk non-English, bulk Heavily Played, bulk Time Spiral Timeshifted, bulk tokens (note: the live rates API still lists a token rate with is_buying=true), bulk with large quantities of any one card. Rates exclude Unfinity/Unstable/Unsanctioned (separate $0.001 line for non-foil R/M) and, for foil rares, Mystery Booster. FAB: non-foil common/rare/super rare/token, rainbow-foil common/rare/SR/token, gold foil, promos, marvel/fabled/legendary rainbow foil are flagged not buying. Lorcana: enchanted, foil enchanted, inkwashed, non-foil promo flagged not buying. Riftbound tokens flagged not buying.
buyers.turnaround: Approval email within 2 business days. Sell List requests processed in 5-7 business days after receipt. Ship + Sell: offer within ~5 business days for up to 1,000 cards (+1 business day per extra 1,000). PayPal paid within 1-2 business days of acceptance; check printed within 2 business days (USPS mail).
buyers.process: Create a Star City account. Either (a) Sell List: add the bulk categories (Sell List > Bulk) to the Sell Cart, choose store credit / PayPal / check, submit, wait for approval email, then ship; or (b) Ship + Sell form for unsorted collections. Do not ship before the approval email.

Per-category updated_at in the API: MTG common/uncommon + foil C/U 2026-07-20; basic land 2026-02-19; rare/mythic/promo/tokens/Unstable 2025-11-11; foil rare/mythic + foil basic 2025-12-04; art cards 2024-10-07; Lorcana mostly 2026-07-20; FAB 2025-11-06; Riftbound C/U non-foil 2026-10-07, rest 2026-07-20.

buyers.store_credit_bonus: +10% if choosing store credit
buyers.minimum: None stated for bulk. Separate rule: collections of 20 cards or more (bulk excluded) pay a $50 deposit once reviewed, waived if you complete the sale.

buyers.condition_rules: Mint/Near Mint only; English cards only. No sleeves on bulk.
buyers.sorting_rules: All cards must be separated by price category/rarity before bringing them in. Common/uncommon Pokemon and Trainers need not be separated but it is preferred: unsorted C/U is accepted at $0.02 ($20 per 1,000), separated pays $0.03 ($30 per 1,000). Any violation "may result in Tabletop Village rejecting the submission". Customer signs the store's bulk sheet.
buyers.excluded: Non-English, non-Mint/NM. Non-holo (plain) Rares are not listed as their own line. Page is Pokemon only; the store's separate "Singles and Products" page pays 50% of market for cards $5+ and 70% for $30+ (not bulk).
buyers.turnaround: Not stated (in-store). Payouts of $100+ are sent by PayPal or Venmo; what is used under $100 is not stated.
buyers.process: Walk in with sorted bulk; staff review; sign the bulk sheet (which acknowledges the deposit rule). No online form on this page.

buyers.minimum: None stated. Submitting the form is not an offer; owner replies by email within 24 hours and may refuse any offer (e.g. if already overloaded with bulk).

buyers.condition_rules: Near Mint only. Packing guide: line every surface of the box with bubble wrap, pack tightly, tape all edges. buyers.excluded: Pokemon C/U 1,000 lines exclude Basic Energy and foils (energy has its own line); MTG C/U excludes tokens, tip cards, basic lands, foils; non-English; World Championship/non-legal cards. YGO bulk category shows no live prices.
